name: pty-controller
description: Lets Claude programmatically send slash commands to itself by going through a parent wrapper process that hosts CC inside a node-pty pseudo-terminal. Requires the companion `mirza-cc` wrapper running — this plugin only writes command requests to a shared state directory; the wrapper reads them and injects keystrokes into the PTY. Without the wrapper, the MCP tool returns a clear error and slash commands are no-ops.
